## Changes made from the upstream version

Modified by SkillOffice on 2026-11-13:

- Widened from system changes to scope, process and system changes, with options compared side by side.
- Required quantified impact on scope, schedule, cost, quality and people, with stated assumptions.
- Kept the impact analysis, risk table, rollback plan, communication plan and approvals, and the communication principles, rewritten in our own words.
- Removed the connector section (ITSM, project tracker, chat), automatic ticket creation and posting to channels, the slash-command usage block and the reference to CONNECTORS.md.
- Added a draft-only status, approval by named roles, a recommendation, and a handoff section.
- Moved the layout into `references/change-template.md`.
